signal: Tessell raised a $60M Series B (total $94M) to expand AI-driven multi-cloud data management and accelerate go-to-market.

email.body1:
Mac, saw Tessell closed its $60M Series B and is leaning hard into multi-cloud GTM expansion.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals quietly go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Tessell off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mac, quick follow-up for Tessell.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline tend to climb faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Tessell needs to cover this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Mac, last bit of proof for Tessell.

Memgraph, a data infrastructure company like yours, had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a benchmark of how Tessell's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Mac, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and I know the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a multi-cloud data motion? I will tailor it to Tessell either way.
